facts.text: I. Saddam and his dog, refrozen as one.
facts.why: Benson freezes Saddam with the extinguisher; Saddam and his dog shatter, then thaw, melt and reform as one creature with the dog's head and ears. They are not refrozen as one.
facts.fix: I. Saddam and his dog, thawed out as one.
facts.applied_text: I. Saddam and his dog, thawed out as one.

vibe.verdict: A smart state dinner with the chicken arrow, the spaghetti strand, the extinguisher and real Benson lines, though it still skips the dentures landing in the Prime Minister's wine.
